concept.hr: Sloj kontejnera, svezak ili vezano montiranje: što rm čuva, a što briše
concept.en: Container layer, volume or bind mount: what rm keeps and what it deletes

summary.hr: Zapiši podatke i ponovno stvori kontejner: sloj za pisanje nestaje s njim, svesci i direktoriji domaćina ostaju, a anonimni svesci ostaju bez vlasnika.
summary.en: Write data, then recreate the container: its writable layer dies with it, volumes and host directories stay, and anonymous volumes are left orphaned.
